WITH rep_counts AS (
  SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName, e.City, COUNT(c.CustomerId) as customer_count
  FROM Employee e
  INNER JOIN Customer c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId
  GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName, e.City
),
city_averages AS (
  SELECT City, AVG(customer_count) as avg_count
  FROM rep_counts
  GROUP BY City
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT rc.EmployeeId, rc.FirstName, rc.LastName, rc.City, rc.customer_count, ca.avg_count
  FROM rep_counts rc
  JOIN city_averages ca ON rc.City = ca.City
  WHERE rc.customer_count > ca.avg_count
)
SELECT 
  City,
  SUM(customer_count) as total_customers_above_avg,
  AVG(customer_count - avg_count) as avg_above_city_average,
  AVG(CAST(customer_count AS REAL) / 59.0) as avg_share_of_overall
FROM above_average
GROUP BY City
ORDER BY City
